# marginal BPOT

```{r,echo=FALSE,warning=FALSE}
source('../scripts/fitBPOT.R')
ci_severe_20 <- lapply(all_bpot_results,FUN = ci_bpot_boot_marginal,q1=x0,q2=20)
ci_severe_30 <- lapply(all_bpot_results,FUN = ci_bpot_boot_marginal,q1=x0,q2=30)
ci_severe_40 <- lapply(all_bpot_results,FUN = ci_bpot_boot_marginal,q1=x0,q2=40)
ci_severe_50 <- lapply(all_bpot_results,FUN = ci_bpot_boot_marginal,q1=x0,q2=50)

plot_prob_ci_box(ci_severe_20,ylab="P(TTC<0,Speed>20 km/h)",
                 filename = "marginal_ci_severe_prob_20.png" )
plot_prob_ci_box(ci_severe_30,ylab="P(TTC<0,Speed>30 km/h)",
                 filename = "marginal_ci_severe_prob_30.png" )
plot_prob_ci_box(ci_severe_40,ylab="P(TTC<0,Speed>40 km/h)",
                 filename = "marginal_ci_severe_prob_40.png" )
plot_prob_ci_box(ci_severe_50,ylab="P(TTC<0,Speed>50 km/h)",
                 filename = "marginal_ci_severe_prob_50.png" )
```

# Joint BPOT
```{r,echo=FALSE,warning=FALSE}
source('../scripts/fitBPOT_joint.R')

all_bpot_models <- lapply(all_bpot_results, function(x) x$M)
ci_severe_20 <- lapply(all_bpot_models,FUN = ci_bpot_boot_joint,q1=x0,q2=20)
ci_severe_30 <- lapply(all_bpot_models,FUN = ci_bpot_boot_joint,q1=x0,q2=30)
ci_severe_40 <- lapply(all_bpot_models,FUN = ci_bpot_boot_joint,q1=x0,q2=40)
ci_severe_50 <- lapply(all_bpot_models,FUN = ci_bpot_boot_joint,q1=x0,q2=50)
plot_prob_ci_box(ci_severe_20,ylab="P(TTC<0,Speed>20 km/h)",
                 filename = "joint_ci_severe_prob_20.png" )
plot_prob_ci_box(ci_severe_30,ylab="P(TTC<0,Speed>30 km/h)",
                 filename = "joint_ci_severe_prob_30.png" )
plot_prob_ci_box(ci_severe_40,ylab="P(TTC<0,Speed>40 km/h)",
                 filename = "joint_ci_severe_prob_40.png" )
plot_prob_ci_box(ci_severe_50,ylab="P(TTC<0,Speed>50 km/h)",
                 filename = "joint_ci_severe_prob_50.png" )
```

# CBPOT
```{r,echo=FALSE,warning=FALSE}

ci_severe_20 <- lapply(all_cbpot_results,FUN = ci_cbpot_boot,x0=x0,y0=20)
ci_severe_30 <- lapply(all_cbpot_results,FUN = ci_cbpot_boot,x0=x0,y0=30)
ci_severe_40 <- lapply(all_cbpot_results,FUN = ci_cbpot_boot,x0=x0,y0=40)
ci_severe_40 <- lapply(all_cbpot_results,FUN = ci_cbpot_boot,x0=x0,y0=50)

plot_prob_ci_box(ci_severe_20,ylab="Q(TTC<0,Speed>20 km/h)",
                 filename = "cbpot_ci_severe_prob_20.png" )
plot_prob_ci_box(ci_severe_30,ylab="Q(TTC<0,Speed>30 km/h)",
                 filename = "cbpot_ci_severe_prob_30.png" )
plot_prob_ci_box(ci_severe_40,ylab="Q(TTC<0,Speed>40 km/h)",
                 filename = "cbpot_ci_severe_prob_40.png" )
```

# best BPOT and CBPOT
```{r,echo=FALSE,warning=FALSE}
best_bpot <- sapply(20:50, function(x) ci_bpot_boot_marginal(alog_M,q1=x0,q2=x)) %>% 
  t() %>% cbind(20:50) %>% as.data.frame()
ggplot(data = best_bpot, aes(x=V4,y=estimate)) +
  geom_line() + 
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin=lower,ymax=upper),alpha=0.2) +
  labs(x="Speed threshold (km/h)",y="P(TTC<0,Speed>threshold)") +
  theme_bw()

best_cbpot <- sapply(20:50, function(x) ci_cbpot_boot(frank_M,x0=x0,y0=x)) %>% 
  t() %>% cbind(20:50) %>% as.data.frame()

ggplot(data = best_cbpot, aes(x=V4,y=estimate)) +
  geom_line() + 
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin=lower,ymax=upper),alpha=0.2) +
  labs(x="Speed threshold (km/h)",y="P(TTC<0,Speed>threshold)") +
  theme_bw()

ggplot() +
  geom_line(data = best_bpot, aes(x=V4,y=estimate,color="asymmetric logistic")) + 
  geom_ribbon(data = best_bpot, aes(x=V4,ymin=lower,ymax=upper,fill="asymmetric logistic"),alpha=0.2) +
  geom_line(data = best_cbpot, aes(x=V4,y=estimate,color="frank copula")) + 
  geom_ribbon(data = best_cbpot, aes(x=V4,ymin=lower,ymax=upper,fill="frank copula"),alpha=0.2) +
  labs(x="Speed threshold (km/h)",y="P(TTC<0,Speed>threshold)") +
  scale_color_manual(name = "Model", values = c("asymmetric logistic" = "blue", "frank copula" = "red")) +
  scale_fill_manual(name = "Model", values = c("asymmetric logistic" = "blue", "frank copula" = "red")) +
  theme_bw()
ggsave("../plots/prob_ci_cont.png",device = "png", width = 7, height = 7, dpi = 300)
```
